name: Géant
description: Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store. Sells groceries, beverages, household and personal care, appliances, technology and toys. Prices on the homepage are valid only for the delivery area, and the delivery zones are published on a separate page not read.
description_es: Cadena de supermercados de Uruguay con tienda online. Vende comestibles, bebidas, limpieza y cuidado personal, electrodomésticos, tecnología y juguetes. Los precios de la página principal son válidos solo para el área de entrega, que se publica en una página separada no leída.

ships_to.notes: Homepage limits prices to the delivery area; delivery zones are on a separate page that was not read.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Three stores listed on the homepage; pickup for online orders not described.
